description: Make the version of a hosted model that was active before the current one active again. Answers 409 when no version was active before. Answers 404 not_released while hosted models (the hosted-pricing-models release) are not switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with function publish scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

model_id.description: The hosted model's id: id on a list_hosted_models result.
